sanskrit_verse:
वाराही चैव माहेन्द्री चामुण्डा गणसंयुता ।
निरृतेर् उत्तरे भागे गणेशायतनं विदुः ॥
transliteration: vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍā gaṇasaṃyutā / nirṛter uttare bhāge gaṇeśāyatanaṃ viduḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: The sacred sites of Vārāhī, Māhendrī, Cāmuṇḍā, and Gaṇasamayuktā are established in the northern quarter of Nirṛti, known as the abode of Gaṇeśa.
